newsitem.title: USA: Century files shelf for $500 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Century files shelf for $500 mln in debt.

text.p: Century Communications Corp filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $500 million in debt securities, senior subordinated debt securities and subordinated debt securities.
The New Canann, Conn.-based cable television company said some of the securities to be issued may be convertible into Class A common shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which many include repaying outstanding debt and financing capital expenditures, the company said.
